in this fiery brew. There! Now, masks, take care! See how it sparkles and spits, how it crackles! The staff is beginning to glow! Crowd too close and you'll end up a cinder! I'll begin my circuit now.

@@U02451@@
(Shouting and jostling.)

@@U02452@@
—Oh, we're done for! —Escape if you can! —Back, get back, you in the rear! —Hot sparks in my face! —The red-hot staff is coming at me! —We're lost, all of us! —Back, get back, you masked fools! —Idiots! —If I had wings, I'd fly!

@@U02454@@
The crowd’s scattered, pushed back, and no one burned, only frightened. Still, for safety’s sake, I'll draw an invisible line.

@@U02456@@
What a magnificent feat! I’m grateful to your wisdom and power!

@@U02458@@
Be patient, my noble friend; there’s more violence to come.

@@U02460@@
Well, now, what do you say we amuse ourselves
translation:
@@U02449@@
在这火热的酿造中。那里！现在，口罩，请保重！看看它如何闪闪发光，如何喷吐，如何噼啪作响！工作人员开始发光了！人群离得太近，你最终会化为灰烬！我现在开始我的循环。

@@U02451@@
（喊叫和推搡。）

@@U02452@@
——噢，我们完了！ ——如果可以的话就逃吧！ ——后退，后退，你在后面！ ——我脸上冒出滚烫的火花！ ——炽热的工作人员向我袭来！ ——我们迷路了，我们所有人！ ——退后，退后，你们这些蒙面傻瓜！ ——白痴们！ ——如果我有翅膀，我就会飞！

@@U02454@@
人群四散，被推开，没有人被烧伤，只有恐惧。不过，为了安全起见，我会划一条看不见的线。

@@U02456@@
这是多么伟大的壮举啊！我感谢您的智慧和力量！

@@U02458@@
要有耐心，我高贵的朋友；还会有更多暴力事件发生。

@@U02460@@
好吧，现在，你说我们自娱自乐怎么样？
